messages:
Maria G: Kicking off a quick preflight for Shipyard GA criteria — want to confirm SLA, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing are all green.
Alex C: ETA for SLA doc updates? I pushed a draft in the repo: https://git.redwood/shipyard/sla.md
Sam I: Saw draft. Need SLOs for p99 latency, availability, and burst capacity. Also fallback behaviors.
Maria G: Exact asks: 1) SLA table + breach penalties 2) Oncall rota + escalation 3) Runbooks and smoke playbook 4) Monitoring dashboards + alerts 5) Pricing tiers + quotas
Elena P: For SLA table propose: 99.9% monthly uptime for paid Dedicated, 99.5% for hosted free tier, p99 < 250ms for standard endpoints — ok?
Pranav D: 250ms p99 is tight for some models. Can we allow model-specific SLOs? e.g., small-gen p99 200ms, large-gen p99 500ms.
Alex C: Agree model-class SLOs. Also want automatic fallback policy documented in SLA so customers know behavior.
Sam I: Monitoring: need baseline dashboards (latency, error-rate, queue-length) + a 'launch smoke' dashboard for owners.
Maria G: Owners: Alex -> SLA & pricing, Sam -> monitoring + runbooks, Elena -> support rota & docs. I'll own rollout coordination.
OpsBot: deploy-bot pushed branch shipyard/sla-v0.2 to staging at commit abc123 :rocket:
Alex C: Docs: add a 'What to expect during incidents' section, and a 'how pricing scales with bursts' FAQ.
Elena P: Support: require 24/7 oncall for Dedicated GA. We'll have weekdays CS+SRE primary, weekend oncall rotation — need confirmation from SRE.
Sam I: I'll add alert runbook snippets:
```
alert: high-p99-latency
if p99_latency > threshold for 3m
  pager -> #eng-oncall
  runbook: restart pool, check cache/memory
```
Maria G: Need signoffs by EOD Friday. If anyone can't make that, flag now.
Mark S: Sales input: pricing tiers look fine, request a pilot discount clause for first 3 customers.
Alex C: Noted. Alex will add clause to pricing draft.
Maria G: Cool. Action items: Alex SLA+pricing, Sam monitors+runbooks, Elena support rota+docs, Maria coordinate signoffs. :white_check_mark:
Elena P: I'll ping SRE owners in #eng-sre today.
Sam I: Added a quick smoke test script to repo: scripts/smoke_launch.sh
Maria G: Thanks team — trying to lock this down for GA on 2/24. Ping me for blockers.
